Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited financial statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the 2025 net profit of Rp 813.99 billion, allocating Rp 331.47 billion for cash dividends at Rp 27 per share and the remainder as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PricewaterhouseCoopers) was appointed to audit the 2026 fiscal year, with the Board of Commissioners authorized to appoint replacements if necessary.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to set salaries and benefits for the Board of Directors and Commissioners, with a maximum gross annual limit of Rp 4.12 billion for the Board of Commissioners.
